description: I met Christiano in Madagascar - the world's poorest island where life is tough. He's 11 years old, and somehow fluent-ish in 5 languages he taught himself just by talking to tourists. Then he gave me a magnet and wouldn't take my money for it. The kid has next to nothing  and he's giving ME gifts. Unreal! Rooting for you, Christiano!
fulltitle: He Speaks 5 Languages But Can't Afford Food
